evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership) so both people and AI tools can trust and correctly interpret the data
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour — data quality, testing in dbt, CI/CD, governance, lineage and compliance dominate; the only speed language is 'when to lean on AI tools for speed'.
evidence.domain_risk: Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High — the JD names explicit compliance, privacy and security obligations and calls the platform 'business-critical', which meets the override signal even though the consumers are internal.
evidence.collaboration_width: No distinctly named partner functions — only 'stakeholders', 'users of all technical levels' and the role's own cross-functional data team.
evidence.data_team_maturity: you will ... join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid — a data team, a Snowflake/dbt platform and Power BI consumers already exist and the role extends them, but there are no specialised data sub-teams.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: hiring_manager — tools are named inside the responsibilities with concrete application context (Snowflake/dbt models, data catalog, access lifecycle), so the day-to-day is legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: internal_data — the mission is self-serve access, a semantic layer and a single source of truth for internal data consumers, with decentralised analytics as the stated goal.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end ... you'll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed — end-to-end ownership of the access and semantic layer sits alongside execution framing like 'Contribute to agile ways of working'.
evidence.ai_role: Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: ai_enabler — the candidate builds the modelled, documented data that AI agents and AI BI assistants consume, alongside using AI copilots themselves; the tie-breaker resolves to enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility — data quality is a stated responsibility bullet with an ownership verb, backed by 'hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt' in the qualifications.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools ... balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High — compliance, privacy and 'a single, trusted definition of key business metrics' frame the role's value as protecting correctness and controlled access, not just delivery.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed — building and defining the semantic layer sits alongside maintaining and continuously improving an existing business-critical platform.
evidence.language_gate: Fluent in written and spoken English (business level)
evidence.urgency: starting as soon as possible in the Stockholm or Munich office
evidence.loss_aversion: 'ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on' — the role is framed around preventing divergent or misinterpreted metric definitions.
